subject: Renewal: CI/CD & Artifact Registry — Buildkite registry add-on (Q2 renewal)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: accounts+renewals@buildkite.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: CI/CD & Artifact Registry — Buildkite registry add-on (Q2 renewal)

Hi team,

Heads-up: our Buildkite contract and the optional registry add-on are up for renewal on 2026-04-01. Current plan: 50 concurrent agents + registry add-on (2TB). Procurement asked me to lock pricing and confirm any upcoming changes in vendor terms before we trigger the annual PO.

Can you send the latest quote and confirm whether the registry add-on terms or ingress/egress billing changed since last year? We're evaluating a 12-month renewal with a potential one-time increase to 3TB if price-per-GB stays within our threshold.

Key constraints:
- Need final quote by 2026-02-18 to approve in time for finance cycle.
- Any change to data retention/export terms needs legal sign-off.
- We're exploring a parallel conversation with Quay/Harbor if there are significant storage cost increases.

Looping in Monica (procurement) and Logan (infra) for approvals and technical validation.

Thanks,
Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (referenced) current_contract_summary.pdf
From: Jessica Nguyen <jessica.nguyen@buildkite.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts+renewals@buildkite.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 13:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: CI/CD & Artifact Registry — Buildkite registry add-on (Q2 renewal)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the heads up.

Attached is the updated renewal quote (Buildkite_renewal_quote_Q2-2026.pdf). Summary: list pricing is unchanged for agent counts; registry add-on pricing does have a small bandwidth adjustment for cross-region egress introduced Jan 2026. For Redwood's usage profile (primarily US-east writes + occasional EU reads), the modeled impact is ~6% increase on monthly registry-related spend.

We can offer a 15% loyalty discount on the registry add-on for a 12-month committed term if you sign the PO by 2026-02-18. No changes to data retention in the add-on — export and retention terms remain as in v1.9 of the registry add-on agreement. Legal redlines are small (we can accept a single CL-3 liability cap change).

Quick items: 
- Quote attached
- Proposed loyalty discount code: RW-LOYALTY-15
- DocuSign link for the renewal (with discount) if accepted: https://www.docusign.net/embeddedSigning/1234ABCD

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30 minute call tomorrow with our registry product manager to walk through bandwidth modeling.

Best,
Jessica Nguyen
Account Executive, Buildkite

Attachments: Buildkite_renewal_quote_Q2-2026.pdf, registry_pricing_model.csv
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: CI/CD & Artifact Registry — Buildkite registry add-on (Q2 renewal)

Thanks Jessica — received.

A few notes from procurement & cost analysis: 
- We ran the pricing through our model. With the 15% loyalty discount, the expected annual spend delta vs. last year is +2.7% assuming steady agent usage and the 3TB cap.
- Finance prefers not to increase committed storage beyond 2TB without a clear forecast — can we provision burst storage and month-to-month overage instead of committing to 3TB?
- Please send the SOW/terms as a Word doc for redlines (we prefer inline comments).

Technical ask for Logan/Karthik: can you validate whether the small egress charge will materially affect CI latency for EU teams and whether we should consider regional pull-proxies to reduce cross-region reads? If so, we might push back on egress billing or negotiate a higher bandwidth allotment.

Procurement timeline: need signed PO to Finance by 2026-02-20 to get on the March vendor payment run.

Monica
Sr. Procurement Manager

Attachment: Registry_addon_terms_v2.docx (please review before legal engages)
From: Jessica Nguyen <jessica.nguyen@buildkite.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: CI/CD & Artifact Registry — Buildkite registry add-on (Q2 renewal)

Appreciate the detailed notes. Quick follow-ups: 

1) Burst storage: yes, we can do a 2TB committed + burst up to 4TB model with overage at the same discounted per-GB rate; that avoids a larger upfront commit. I'll update the quote and the DocuSign package.

2) Egress: we can add an EU-read waiver for the first 100TB/year for the renewal term — effectively removing the small egress charge for your EU teams. That is an exception we can include in the SOW if legal signs off.

3) Terms: attaching a Word copy of registry add-on terms with the proposed exception (see Registry_addon_terms_v2.docx). 

If you confirm the burst model and the waiver, I'll send the updated DocuSign link with the RW-LOYALTY-15 discount applied.

Jess

Attachment: Registry_addon_terms_v2.docx (with waiver markup)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Nguyen <jessica.nguyen@buildkite.com>, accounts+renewals@buildkite.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 16:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: CI/CD & Artifact Registry — Buildkite registry add-on (Q2 renewal)

Jessica — this looks good. Redwood agrees to: 
- 12-month renewal at current agent levels (50 concurrent)
- Registry add-on: 2TB committed + burst to 4TB, with the EU-read 100TB/year waiver included
- Apply RW-LOYALTY-15 discount to the registry add-on

Monica, please approve PO/attach to the HubSpot deal and route to finance. Karthik/Logan, if you see any technical red flags, flag now — otherwise we'll proceed.

Jessica, send the updated DocuSign link and I'll route for signature today. Need it in finance for the 2026-02-20 run.

Thanks,
Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations

DocuSign placeholder link (awaiting updated package): https://www.docusign.net/embeddedSigning/1234ABCD
